sourceHtml:
Overview

This week

This week 0 of 3 lifts done

The same schedule applies to the gym, home and minimal programs. Days can move around, but keep a rest day or an upper-body day between Lift A and Lift C so the legs recover.

  • MonLift ALower body + mobility
  • TueBasketballSkills + conditioning
  • WedLift BUpper body + core
  • ThuBasketballSkills + conditioning
  • FriLift CLower body + plyo
  • SatRecoveryMobility only
  • SunRestFull rest

In this plan

  • Workout logWrite down the weights and reps you actually lifted, then watch the trend for each exercise.
  • Weekly programThree lifts and two basketball sessions a week, in three versions: gym, home equipment, or one kettlebell and bands.
  • Full bodyA standalone beginner session for the gym: squat, hinge, push, pull, press, step-up and core.
  • Recovery dayThree light options for days when your muscles are still sore: an easy walk with upper body work, isometric holds, or legs and ankles holds.
  • Session timesHow long each gym session takes with the warm-up included.
  • Nutrition planAbout 2,550 kcal and 200 g protein a day to lose 5 kg of fat in 10 to 12 weeks.
  • MealsTwelve protein-heavy meals with gram amounts for every ingredient.
  • Grocery listMonthly staples bought at Lidl, MyMarket and the open-air market, with a cost estimate.
